role: Preregistered contract for the warm-start study. It fixes the methods, the hyperparameters chosen on validation, the metrics, and the pass bars before the test split is scored. It holds no test number.
question: Can an FNO first guess plus a bounded solver-in-the-loop refinement reach solver-level viscosity accuracy on the frozen hard_ood slice at a fraction of the cold solver search wall clock, with calibrated nominal 0.9 intervals?

solver_search.returned_value: evaluated point, not an interpolated vertex
solver_search.targets: every burst except the opening burst

cold_start.timed_span: the scalar search and every forward solve; building the solver problem is excluded
cold_start.order_within_worker: cold search first, then every warm start on the same field

first_guess.objective: Stage D sparse-rollout sensor mean square at lambda 0 (docs/v02/stage_d_inverse_protocol.json)
first_guess.batched: every grid viscosity is one batch of a single forward rollout
first_guess.timed_span: mask read, window construction, and every rollout; checkpoint loading is excluded
first_guess.reason: Fixed before validation by cost: the published 191-point linear grid takes about a tenth of the cold search wall clock per instance, which leaves too little of the time budget for refinement.

refine_notes.algorithm: Gauss-Newton in s = log nu on the sensor residual vector of the cold-start objective. The first Jacobian is a one-sided difference with probe_step; later Jacobians are secants between the lowest-loss point and its nearest evaluated neighbour. Iterates are clipped to a box of half-width trust_radius around the first guess, intersected with [nu_min, nu_max]. The loop stops when the next step is at most step_tolerance or after max_evaluations solves and returns the final Gauss-Newton prediction.

methods.primary_description: warm start from each full-range FNO hybrid_1e-2 seed; one estimate per seed
secondary: full/data_only: warm start from each full-range data-loss seed
full/<arm>/ensemble: warm start from the median of the five seed first guesses of one arm
restricted/<arm>: the same methods with the Stage F restricted-range operators

retraining.reason: No Stage B, C, D, or F checkpoint is in git, and Stage D committed per-instance estimates only for the test split, on the 191-point grid. Validation estimates for calibration, noisy-field estimates, and restricted-range first guesses need the networks.

retraining.bitwise_reproduction: 0 of 20 retrained checkpoints match both the published selected epoch and the published validation relative L2 exactly. The validation record lists the retrained and published values side by side, and the retrained Stage D validation inverse errors next to the published ones.

intervals.quantile: the ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha))-th smallest validation score
intervals.groups: predicted_hard_ood if nu_hat <= threshold_nu, else predicted_complement; the true nu is not read
intervals.small_group: a group with fewer than min_group validation rows uses the pooled quantile
intervals.selection_rule: smallest two-fold cross-fitted mean log half-width on validation; folds by instance_id parity
intervals.calibration: per method on the whole validation split; quantiles are stored in the validation record

abstain.selection_rule: smallest two-fold cross-fitted mean relative error on accepted validation instances at the fixed rate
abstain.threshold: per method, the ceil(n (1 - rate))-th smallest validation statistic; abstain when strictly above

selected_on_validation.cap_rule: smallest cap with time_ratio <= 0.2 whose mean hard_ood relative error is within a factor 1.02 of the best such cap; if none, the fastest cap

pass_bars.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the five seeds of the per-seed slice statistic

error.statement: hard_ood mean relative error <= 1.5 x the published solver_sensor_ic hard_ood mean

time.statement: hard_ood mean warm-start wall clock <= 0.25 x the hard_ood mean cold-search wall clock, both measured in this run on this machine

coverage.statement: full_test empirical coverage of the nominal 0.9 interval in [0.85, 0.95]

pass_bars.overall: pass only if all three bars pass

reported_not_bars: abstain rate and error on accepted and abstained instances, every slice
paired per-instance differences against the cold search
secondary methods, noise conditions, and restricted-range operators

noise.methods: full-range per-seed and ensemble warm starts, and the cold search re-run on the same noisy fields
noise.calibration: the clean validation calibration; nothing is refit for noise

stage_f.calibration: validation instances with nu > threshold_nu only
stage_f.slices: hard_ood is outside the training range of these operators; complement is inside it

aggregation.unit: one scalar per seed per slice
aggregation.deterministic: the cold search and the ensembles are one run each
aggregation.paired_delta: warm relative error minus cold relative error on the same instance; negative means warm is lower

limitations: One scalar viscosity, one-dimensional periodic Burgers, and the Stage A pilot. This is not a multi-equation benchmark.

The warm start minimizes the same sensor-lift objective as the cold search. It cannot be more accurate than that objective allows except by stopping at a different point; the oracle initial condition is the ceiling for both.
Wall clock is one CPU machine with the protocol worker count. Ratios, not absolute seconds, are the object of the time bar.
The networks were retrained for this study with the frozen commands. They are not bitwise copies of the published Stage B, C, and F networks.
Validation timing ran while other jobs shared the machine. Only the cap choice read validation time.
Coverage is marginal over instances and calibrated on one validation split of the same pilot. It is not conditional coverage for a given viscosity.
not_claimed: a retuned hard_ood threshold, sensor mask, solver search, or Stage A through F protocol
a change to any previously reported number
that the warm start is more accurate than the cold search; the bar is accuracy within a factor of the cold search
speed-ups on other machines, other worker counts, GPUs, or other solvers
coverage conditional on viscosity, on noise level, or outside the training range
that the abstain flag detects every large error
any result for viscosity ranges, equations, or observation masks outside this pilot
